The Company also expects to announce additional local language films and exclusive IMAX events and experiences to be released to its global network in 2026 and beyond.

The Company partnered with MGM Studios in March 2026 and Universal Pictures in June 2026 to present exclusive Q&A livestreams in advance of screenings of Project Hail Mary and Disclosure Day , respectively, across select connected IMAX locations in North America.

The installation of IMAX Systems in theaters or multiplexes, which make up a large portion of the Company’s system backlog, depends primarily on the timing of the construction of those projects, which is not under the Company’s control.

The year-over-year increase in total global box office was primarily attributable to the box office performance of Christopher Nolan’s record breaking, global tentpole Filmed For IMAX release, The Odyssey , which became the Company’s highest grossing film of all time, along with significant contributions from Hollywood releases Project Hail Mary , Avatar: Fire and Ash and alternative content release Michael .

Increases and decreased in stock-based compensation expense primarily reflects life-to-date adjustments for the Company’s performance stock unit grants which fluctuate based on the Company’s Adjusted EBITDA outlook until such time as the respective units vest.

The Company continues to expense its investment in other projects, including in the development of new product offerings, data and software projects and improvements to its existing IMAX System and camera product suite.

Management’s judgments regarding expected credit losses are based on the facts available to management at the time that the Condensed Consolidated Financial Statements are prepared and involve estimates about the future.

Management evaluates the realizability of deferred tax assets on a quarterly basis by considering all available positive and negative evidence, including recent operating results, forecasts of future taxable income, and other relevant factors specific to our industry such as the success of new film releases.

The Company forecasts its future cash flow and short-term liquidity requirements on an ongoing basis.
As a result, there is no guarantee that these forecasts will come to fruition and that the Company will be able to fund its operations through cash flows from operations.

In particular, the Company’s operating cash flows and cash balances will be adversely impacted if management’s projections of future signings and installations of IMAX Systems and box office performance of IMAX content are not realized.

Based on the Company’s current cash balances and operating cash flows, management expects to have sufficient capital and liquidity to fund its anticipated operating needs and capital requirements during the next twelve-month period following the date of this report.
GAAP requires management to make judgments, assumptions, and estimates that affect the amounts reported in the Company’s Condensed Consolidated Financial Statements and accompanying notes.
Actual results may ultimately differ from the Company’s original estimates, as future events and circumstances sometimes do not develop as expected, and the differences may be material.
